lee_support: Escalating Quasar Tech — onboarding blocked after new API key rollout, their staging ingest failing and customer worried about renewal next week.
maya_cs: thanks for flagging. what errors are they seeing? any logs?
rene_eng: we're returning 403s from embeddings ingest for tenant quasar-21. snippet:
```
POST /v1/embeddings -> 403 Forbidden
{"error":"invalid_api_key","detail":"client id mismatch"}
```
lee_support: customer contact is sam@quasar.io. They rotated keys but our provisioning job missed the updated external_id mapping at 09:22 UTC.
maya_cs: mark this P0 for CS — blocks go-live and could impact renewal. Need an external comms note + owners assigned within 20m. Also pause renewal nudges.
noah_sales: pausing automated renewal reminders now. If unresolved >3h, approve offering 2 weeks credit.
rene_eng: remediation: manual re-sync of tenant mapping and warm restart of embed workers. ETA 30m if ops accepts change.
lee_support: deploy-bot: request tenant resync for quasar-21 with external_id=quasar-ext-9
deploy-bot: INF-5203 created and assigned to rene_eng, change window: immediate.
rene_eng: applying mapping change and restarting workers. will post verification output.
rene_eng: mapping updated, workers restarted. test payloads accepted, no more 403s in staging.
lee_support: running smoke in prod now; embeddings accepted and search results returned. Sam at Quasar confirmed staging looks good.
maya_cs: drafting external: "We're aware of an ingestion failure after a key rotation. Engineering applied a fix and service is restored. We'll follow up with details and a credit if needed." Sending now.
noah_sales: I'll prepare billing note and loop finance. owners: ENG=rene_eng, SUPPORT=lee_support, CS=maya_cs, SALES=noah_sales.
deploy-bot: INF-5203 updated: change executed and verified; awaiting billing note for closure. Closing ETA: 48h.
lee_support: closing thread for now — will reopen on regression. :white_check_mark:
